definition: Async/await is syntax for asynchronous code that reads as a sequence of steps. An async function can pause at await until a promise settles, then continue with the result. The pause suspends that function; it does not block the whole thread on the wait.
details: The function returns a promise of its own. A failure in an awaited promise rejects that returned promise unless it is handled.
examples: Awaiting a database query before using the rows
Awaiting two independent requests one after another
